ValidationRule.description: IF Closed Lost Reason is 'Others' and Closed Lost Others field is empty and vice versa.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($RecordType.Name = "Agent Acquisition",(OR((INCLUDES( Closed_Lost_Reason__c ,'Others') && ISBLANK( Closed_Lost__c)), (NOT(INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c ,'Others')) && NOT(ISBLANK( Closed_Lost__c))))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Align values between "Closed Lost Reason" and "Closed Lost Reason Others".
